origin: it should NOT report appending 2 items
source:
defmodule CredoSampleModule do
  def some_function(parameter1, parameter2) do
    [parameter1] ++ [parameter2]
  end
end

origin: it should NOT report prepending an item
source:
defmodule CredoSampleModule do
  def some_function(parameter1, parameter2) do
    [parameter1] ++ parameter2
  end
end

origin: it should NOT report on 2 lists
source:
defmodule CredoSampleModule do
  def some_function(parameter1, parameter2) do
    parameter1 ++ parameter2
  end
end

origin: it should NOT report appending 2 items on a pre-existing list
source:
defmodule CredoSampleModule do
  def some_function(list, parameter1, parameter2) do
    list ++ [parameter1, parameter2]
  end
end

defmodule CredoSampleModule do
  def some_function(parameter1, parameter2) do
    parameter1 ++ [parameter2]
  end
end

findings.message: Appending a single item to a list is inefficient, use `[head | tail]` notation (and `Enum.reverse/1` when order matters).
